notes.title: Demo Version Now Available
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that a free single player demo of the game is now available from the store to download.

In the demo play at Rorkes Drift where the gameplay is based off the true story of survival from Rorkes Drift where 150 British soldiers fought off a force of around 4000 Zulus. The true story was also the basis for the 1960's movie Zulu.

In the full game play on landscape that has been developed and based off satellite images and old drawings and maps from 1879. Similarly the gameplay has been based of true events from the 1879 war.

Game Configuration
Adjust weapon effectiveness including melee hits, spear and gun damage plus a host of other game specific parameters that effect both gameplay and how the AI may respond.

notes.content:

    Fix issue with training 
    Fix issue where medic count not always updated on scoreboard on some maps
    Fix issue where 4th British character's squad kill count not counted correctly on some maps


In our next patch we plan to include the singleplayer map based off the Battle of Hlobane

notes.title: Update 0.971 Available
notes.content:
We've just made available to download the latest patch v0.971

Key changes include the Command Dial for ordering your AI, enhanced blood effects and new movement and attack options for the Zulu player's AI.

    Fixes for blood and spear collisions
    New 1st person animations

notes.title: Upgrades and Rewards Explained
notes.content:
We've just released a video on Youtube that explains many of the upgrades and rewards available for the Rorkes Drift maps.

Watch it now

British Upgrades and Rewards

Many earned through the battle skills of the AI you command :

Medic - Upgrade player to Medic 
Engineer - Upgrade your AI and they can repair wall breaches
Morale - Restore soldier morale
Sword - Gain a sword after excellence in battle
Horse Attack - Additional sword and riding skills whilst on horse (not available at Rorkes Drift)
Reserves - Receive extra reserves for battle skill
Trade In medals awarded for extra reserves or upgrade AI to crack shots


Zulu Upgrades and Rewards

Most upgrades become available as your warriors fight in battle :

Chant - If performed close to the British may lower British morale and reward you with additional reserves
Frenzy - Warriors run faster have more health and are more aggressive
Flaming Torches - Upgrade your AI or call in new warriors who can burn down buildings
Cattle Rewards - Trade in cattle for extra reserves

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
After a gentle reminder I agree that an update on development might be a bit over due.

Currently wed are doing alot of testing and we seem to be in a cycle of testing and fixing issues discovered.

However we have also been adjusting a number of the in game features: 

amended in game upgrades/rewards such as healing soldiers as a medic, enabling your soldiers to repair wall breaches at Rorkes Drift (they carry a shovel instead of a gun until the upgrade timer expires) and use of flaming torches for the Zulu.
New animations for the horse and adjusted kill abilities

The newest additions to the game include:

The Mbilini map was only going to be for network games however you can now play that in SP as well
The Zulu can now pickup thrown spears, there were some unexpected challenges which impacted development but they have been resolved. A Zulu player can now replenish his stock of spears from warriors he commands or from the ground.


The aim now is to focus on testing, mainly for network games so we can aim to release on Early Access before the end of September (no promises hence why the store hasn't been updated with a date), there are challenges but we are getting there.

notes.title: Latest Video Trailer
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce we have a new video trailer for the game which can be seen on the  store page  or here through  Youtube 

Sorry about the delay for this trailer but development has been hectic, some of the things that have been occupying our time include horse attacks by the rider:

sword stab and lunge forward on right to attack an enemy forward of the player on the saddle
slash an enemy with sword on right side and slightly behind player on the saddle
run over enemy with horse, success depends on combination of horse speed, angle and force of hit on enemy
slash an enemy with sword on left side and slightly behind player on the saddle (requires in game XP)
rear up a horse to kill an enemy in front whilst at walking speed (requires in game XP)


Early Access Release Date
Yes I know I'll get asked in comments about the release date for Early Access so before you ask; I intend to release for EA at the end of the northern Summer if testing goes well. We want the game to be playable so you get to enjoy it. I'd like to commit to a date but would rather have slippage (yes I know it has already has) then release something too early with unplayable issues.

notes.title: Frenzy, Fear and Log
notes.content:
Thought you might like to hear about some of the new features we've been working on, Frenzy mode, further Fear additions and a scrolling in game log for co-op and MP.
Frenzy
The Zulu player can get his warriors to go into a Frenzy, they begin with some shield thumping which puts the fear into the Brits and then they charge off to the target area assigned by the player. They have a more aggressive run plus they can take extra damage. Same applies to the player. Each Frenzy lasts for a short period.
Fear
You may recall from our announcement last month that we've added Fear.  The Fear system is still being working on. We have new additions such as Frenzy and a close shave ... and as a reminder in case you prefer not to play with it on, most features and gameplay are configurable so you can choose to play with fear or not before starting a game (network games, host chooses).
Log
We've added for network games a scrolling log showing significant player events, such as kill/death and rewards (e.g. frenzy)
Anything Else?
 Release 
I've had a few queries about release. As mentioned before the game will be released for EA (for the Rorkes Drift and Mbilini games) when development for gameplay and those maps are mostly complete and we feel its stable and playable. 

We wont be date driven. Hopefully this means we can release an EA game that meets both yours and our expectations ... I mentioned late spring early summer previously however I think we need to push back a little but northern summer should be achievable.

 Trailer 
Yes the current trailer is quite a bit out of date, yes this needs to be addressed and is on our task list.

notes.title: Morale and Fear
notes.content:
A brief update on what we've been up to ...

Aside form the usual testing and fixing of issues we've starting development (it'll keep us busy over the short term) on fear and morale which kicks in and  impacts the British player when the zulu approach en masse or if the zulu break into an intimidating chant. 

The game assesses the British morale and may encourage the Zulu to chant. If the zulu player gets his warriors near and orders a chant he'll benefit.

To counter the British player has a means to restore or keep up morale for themselves and/or squad.

Config Turn On/Off

notes.title: Morale and Fear
notes.content:
A brief update on what we've been up to ...

Aside form the usual testing and fixing of issues we've starting development (it'll keep us busy over the short term) on fear and morale which kicks in and  impacts the British player when the zulu approach en masse or if the zulu break into an intimidating chant. 

The game assesses the British morale and may encourage the Zulu to chant. If the zulu player gets his warriors near and orders a chant he'll benefit.

To counter the British player has a means to restore or keep up morale for themselves and/or squad.

Config Turn On/Off
As usual there'll be a config so game hosts (MP or SP) can choose to turn it on/off prior to starting a game.

notes.title: Swords, Clubs, Blood and Cattle
notes.content:
Thought an Easter Update might be welcome, therefore some of the more interesting things we've been working on include:

    Swords, yes we finally have a sword as a weapon. Like all our weapons the hit damage can be adjusted to your preference prior to starting a game
    We've also added a club for the Zulu player as well, hit damage can also be adjusted
    Blood, we've now actually added blood (still basic but is undergoing further development) plus a config where you can choose to turn on blood or not. BTW, to clarify for a few of the eagle eyes out there, the trailer video does not show blood, it was a generic effect applied on any impact. Its just taken a while to get to it in the development cycle
Cattle, they have now been added to the Mbilini maps although they will require some animation adjustments. Cattle are used in the gameplay for this map as the Zulu must capture and escort them back to their territory or alternatively capture their location point (2 differing modes of play chosen at game start) and the British .... they must stop them of course


Swords, clubs and blood available in all games: SP, MP and co-op

Also in case its not readily understood, for network MP and co-op games, the host chooses the game config settings which are then applied to all players. The server browser currently indicates some of the config options but not all.

notes.title: Prince Mbilini Skirmish
notes.content:
Mbilini Map
First off this announcement is a little overdue so apologies. 

For the eagle eyes who are aware that we have engagements planned for Rorkes Drift, Isandlwana, Fugitives Drift, Ntombe River and the Hlobane mountain top, we'd like to announce that there's a new map currently in the making which we hope to have ready when we enable EA release.

Prince Mbilini was the chief who orchestrated the successful attacks at Ntombe and Hlobane but was fatally wounded after a skirmish with the British whilst trying to grab some cattle.

Hence, we've created a new MP map based on this event.

If you'd like to have a bo peep, there's a few new images uploaded on the store page which do include this map.

Other Stuff
For those interested in development stuff we're currently:

    Working on in game upgrades such as to Medic and engineer (your bots carry a shovel for a limited time)
    Ability to choose to host your own games either by dedicated servers or p2p hosting with options to filter in the browser. 
    Adding new lighting and effects to enhance the landscape. The new map images show some of these


Some Repeated Questions
There's been a few repeated questions so I'll attempt to answer them here:

When will EA release happen
Its our intention that the maps and gameplay we release for EA will be playable and as best free of bugs that we can see. We are not racing to meet some publishers deadline so we'll release when we think we've met those objectives. Late spring is an early guesstimate.

Can I play Person X
Depends on the person but each player can choose from a combatant at the battle

Will there be Swords
Its a weapon not currently coded but is a task on our rather large development list. Will it be there for EA launch .... :\

New Media etc
After adding some new post processing effects to enhance the graphic visuals we are looking to add some new videos. We'll keep you posted.

Thanks.
